page.title: Studio
page.purpose: Author and workshop a page's experience spec cheaply: edit claims in a form beside a live wireframe, compare variants side by side, and promote the chosen one.

priorities.statement: The spec form and its live wireframe read as one linked surface — edit here, see it there.
There is exactly one obvious way forward at any moment: Save while editing, Promote while comparing.
Validation feedback lands next to the field that caused it, at the moment it is caused.

states.description: Editing a spec: form beside live wireframe.
Nothing selected; guides picking a scenario/page to spec.
Two or more variants rendered side by side, promote affordance per variant.
Save acknowledged immediately; busy state, duplicate submission prevented.
Contract findings from live validation, placed field-level with a form-level summary.
Save failed; user input preserved, retry available.

regions.purpose: Render the Studio's loading, ready, empty, partial, or failed specification editing surface.

elements.name: Wireframe preview
elements.description: Deterministic render of the spec being edited, claims annotated in place.

elements.name: Validation summary
elements.description: Form-level summary shown on failed submit; field-level messages sit beside their fields.

claims.statement: While editing, Save is the single dominant action; nothing competes with it.
While comparing variants, Promote is the single dominant action.
The spec form and the wireframe preview are both perceivable while editing.
During compare, the variant rail exposes each variant as a distinct list entry.
The nothing-selected state guides the author to pick a scenario and page — never a blank canvas with no path.
claims.rationale: v1 BAS reconciliation captures only the default state; this empty-state promise needs multi-state capture before it can be machine tier.

claims.statement: A failed submit produces a form-level validation summary exposed as an alert.
claims.rationale: Requires a scripted failed-submit interaction; route-level capture cannot force the alert state yet.

claims.statement: Edits reflect in the wireframe preview without an explicit refresh action.
claims.rationale: Behavioral liveness; attested until a scripted BAS interaction check exists (promotion candidate via OT-P1-002 scaffolding).

claims.statement: Field-level validation appears adjacent to the offending field at the moment it is caused, per the DESIGN.md feedback contract.
The form preserves all user input across a failed save; nothing is retyped.
Form and wireframe are simultaneously visible on desktop and read as one linked surface, not two competing panels.
claims.rationale: The Studio's identity claim; becomes checkable with the P2 saliency tier.
